WITH regional AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region,
           AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                    WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed_amount,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE t.date >= '1996-05-09' AND t.date <= '1998-01-06'
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS overall_avg
    FROM regional
)
SELECT r.region,
       r.avg_signed_amount,
       r.transaction_count,
       r.avg_signed_amount / o.overall_avg AS ratio
FROM regional AS r
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL;
